text:
¡Adiós! ¡Adiós!, si al suspirar el wind

Among las flowers of your hogar querido

Remeda alguna vez hondo gemido

That un pecho exhala in his letal tormento,


Escucha there my voice; será el lamento

Of the bardo sad by your love herido,

That a demandarte irá that no al olvido

His nombre legues in fatal momento.


Adiós, my bien; doquiera la ventura

Your senda borde with fragantes flowers

Dignas of your beldad, of your soul pura.


Adiós, and sé happy; that always ignores.

In tanto that padezco, la amargura

Of los tristes recuerdos punzadores.

translation.title: ¡Adiós!
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
